section_headings: What are the genetics of Hulkberry?
How long does Hulkberry take to flower?

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: 65% sativa / 35% indica
Genetics: OG Kush × Strawberry Diesel
Breeder: Royal Queen Seeds
THC Content: 27%
CBD Content: Low, typically below 1%
Terpene Profile: limonene , myrcene , and linalool
Primary Flavors: Citrus, diesel, strawberry, berry
Flowering Time (Indoor): 9–10 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Late September
Indoor Yield: 400–450 g/m²
Outdoor Yield: 650–700 g per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Hulkberry approaches the familiar OG-and-Diesel formula from a more energetic direction. Rather than producing the slow, body-heavy experience commonly associated with powerful Kush marijuana, Royal Queen Seeds developed this cultivar to emphasize the soaring side of the famous OG Kush × Strawberry Diesel combination. The breeder describes it as its interpretation of the highly regarded Bruce Banner #3 phenotype, with roughly 65% sativa genetics, exceptionally high THC potential, and a clear, uplifting effect.

Its personality is built around contrasts: thick Kush-like flowers carrying strawberry sweetness, sharp fuel paired with citrus, and a forceful cerebral high followed by enough physical relaxation to keep the experience grounded. For experienced cannabis consumers who appreciate potent weed but do not necessarily want immediate couch-lock, Hulkberry occupies a particularly interesting place among modern high-THC hybrids.
Genetics and Lineage

The breeder-confirmed lineage is OG Kush × Strawberry Diesel. Royal Queen Seeds states this cross directly in its current cultivar data sheet and describes Hulkberry as a seed-based version designed around characteristics associated with Bruce Banner #3. OG Kush provides the heavier structural and aromatic foundation. Its influence is evident in the swollen, resinous flowers, pronounced stretch during bloom, earthy fuel notes, and deep potency. Strawberry Diesel contributes a contrasting fruitier character along with more vigorous cerebral stimulation, creating a hybrid that behaves considerably differently from a conventional Kush-dominant marijuana strain.

Phenotype variation remains part of the genetic picture. Royal Queen Seeds describes three notable expressions within the seed line. The predominant #3-style phenotype leans toward OG Kush while retaining subtle strawberry aromatics; another expression sits closer to a true 50/50 balance; and a third can resemble Strawberry Diesel more strongly. That range explains why two properly grown plants from the same seed pack may differ noticeably in stretch, aroma, flower structure, and perceived effect. Growers interested in maintaining a mother plant may therefore find phenotype selection especially worthwhile.

The association with Bruce Banner sometimes creates confusion about the cultivar’s identity. Hulkberry should be understood specifically as Royal Queen Seeds’ OG Kush × Strawberry Diesel breeding line rather than automatically assuming every product labeled Bruce Banner or Hulkberry is genetically identical. RQS explicitly frames its version around the desirable #3-type expression while offering it as feminized seed. For strain-reference purposes, the breeder attribution and documented parents are therefore more dependable than relying on the nickname alone.
Effects and Experience

Mental acceleration usually defines the first stage. The high can develop rapidly, bringing a pronounced shift in mood and perception before substantial body heaviness has time to establish itself. Royal Queen Seeds characterizes the experience as clear and uplifting, while consumer data also frequently associates the cultivar with energetic and creative effects. Conversation may become more animated, music more absorbing, and creative tasks easier to become lost in. Compared with sedating Kush hybrids, the initial effect has considerably more forward momentum.

As the experience stretches out, the OG side becomes easier to recognize. Physical tension can begin to soften while the cerebral component remains active, producing a peculiar combination of mental altitude and bodily calm. Moderate amounts may suit music, art, gaming, social situations, or an unhurried afternoon when strong intoxication will not interfere with responsibilities. Royal Queen Seeds describes the high as long-lasting and primarily head-oriented, with a residual relaxing component developing underneath.

Dose makes an enormous difference. The breeder lists THC potential up to 27%, and its historical description notes samples approaching 28%, placing this cultivar firmly in high-potency territory. At heavier amounts, the bright cerebral effects can become disorienting rather than productive, and the later physical relaxation may grow much more pronounced. Consumer reports include dry mouth, dry eyes, and dizziness among possible unwanted effects. New or THC-sensitive consumers should therefore approach this weed conservatively.
Medical Benefits

High-potency cannabis with a stimulating opening may appeal to some medical marijuana consumers seeking a temporary change in mood or relief from the psychological weight of stress. Consumer feedback associated with Hulkberry includes mentions of low mood, headaches, and pain, although the available strain-specific data are limited and based largely on self-reporting rather than controlled clinical research. Its energetic character may make small amounts more practical during the day than deeply sedating marijuana, while larger servings tend to become less functional.

Physical discomfort is another reason high-THC cannabis is sometimes used medically, but the evidence requires careful interpretation. A 2026 Cochrane review of cannabis-based medicines for chronic neuropathic pain concluded that evidence for substantial pain relief from THC-dominant products remains uncertain and that nervous-system adverse effects may increase. That broader research cannot tell us whether Hulkberry itself will relieve pain, and a strain name does not guarantee a standardized cannabinoid composition.

Appetite stimulation may also occur after a strong session, particularly as the high settles. Still, consumers should avoid treating the cultivar as a medication simply because its effects seem compatible with certain symptoms. Anyone considering cannabis for persistent pain, anxiety, appetite loss, depression, insomnia, or another medical condition should discuss dosing, drug interactions, and potential risks with a qualified healthcare professional.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The aromatic character does not neatly belong to either parent. Fresh flowers can release a dense mixture of ripe berries and sweet fruit before sharper notes of diesel, citrus peel, earth, and herbs become apparent. Royal Queen Seeds specifically describes berry aromas competing with classic fuel and lemon-lime characteristics, while its data sheet lists citrus, diesel, herbal, and pepper among the principal flavors. The Strawberry Diesel ancestry becomes especially obvious in fruit-forward phenotypes, where a recognizable strawberry-like sweetness can sit above the darker Kush foundation.

Limonene, myrcene, and linalool are commonly associated with Hulkberry profiles, though growers should not assume those compounds will appear in identical proportions in every plant. Cannabis terpene production changes with genetics, temperature, light intensity, nutrition, harvest timing, drying, and storage. The strain’s strong citrus character is consistent with limonene-rich expressions, while myrcene can complement its earthy and fruitier tones and linalool may contribute softer floral accents. Royal Queen Seeds documents limonene, linalool, and myrcene prominently in the closely related HulkBerry Automatic line, further illustrating the aromatic tendencies found in this genetic family.

On the palate, the balance frequently reverses several times. Citrus and sweet berry may appear immediately, followed by an earthy diesel character through the middle of the inhale. Pepper, herbs, pine-like sharpness, and sour fruit can remain after exhaling. A proper cure matters considerably with this cultivar; overdried buds may retain the heavier fuel and earth while losing much of the volatile strawberry and lemon-lime character that makes the complete profile distinctive.
Growing Information

Hulkberry is a relatively compact plant during early growth, but growers should not mistake that restraint for an absence of stretch. Royal Queen Seeds lists indoor heights around 80–140 cm and specifically warns that the colas can stretch and swell considerably after flowering begins. Outdoors, the plant generally reaches approximately 160–200 cm. Its branching pattern works particularly well with SOG and ScrOG systems, both of which are recommended by the breeder. A trellis can help distribute the canopy while providing support once the flowers begin gaining substantial weight.

Flowering takes approximately 60–70 days, translating to roughly nine or ten weeks in most indoor gardens. Under appropriate conditions, Royal Queen Seeds gives an indoor harvest range of 400–450 g/m². Outdoor plants can reach 650–700 g each and generally finish around late September in the Northern Hemisphere. The relatively early outdoor finish is useful for growers in areas where autumn rain arrives before many long-flowering sativas have fully matured.

Vigor and outdoor durability are additional strengths. RQS describes the plant as having stout growth, sturdy branches, substantial trichome production, and useful pest resistance. Even so, dense late-flowering buds require adequate airflow and humidity control. Indoor cultivators should thin congested growth where necessary and support heavily loaded branches before they bend. The biggest challenge is less about keeping the plant alive than controlling stretch, maintaining an even canopy, and preserving the aromatic quality of the resin through harvest and curing.
FAQ
Is Hulkberry indica or sativa?

Royal Queen Seeds classifies Hulkberry as 65% sativa and 35% indica. The effects generally reflect that balance, with an energetic and uplifting cerebral beginning accompanied by a gentler physical relaxation later in the experience.
What are the genetics of Hulkberry?

The official genetics are OG Kush × Strawberry Diesel. Royal Queen Seeds developed its seed line to emphasize traits associated with the celebrated Bruce Banner #3 expression of this genetic combination.
How strong is Hulkberry weed?

The breeder currently lists THC content up to 27%, while earlier descriptions report individual samples testing near 28%. This makes it best suited to consumers who already understand their response to high-THC marijuana.
What does Hulkberry taste like?

The flavor combines citrus, diesel, herbs, pepper, berry, strawberry sweetness, and earthy Kush notes. Royal Queen Seeds particularly emphasizes the contrast between fruity berry aromas and fuel-heavy lemon-lime characteristics.
How long does Hulkberry take to flower?
Indoor flowering typically lasts 60–70 days, or about nine to ten weeks. Outdoor plants generally reach harvest around late September under suitable Northern Hemisphere conditions.
Final Thoughts on Hulkberry

Hulkberry earns its reputation through more than extreme THC numbers. The Royal Queen Seeds cross of OG Kush and Strawberry Diesel combines two very different styles of cannabis into a cultivar that retains the resin, fuel, and structural character of Kush while introducing berry sweetness and an unmistakably more energetic mental effect. The breeder’s 65/35 sativa-to-indica classification captures that personality well: this is potent weed that tends to climb upward mentally before its physical weight becomes obvious.

Growers also get unusually practical traits for such a powerful hybrid. The 60–70-day flowering period is manageable, outdoor harvest comes relatively early, plants can produce around 650–700 grams each under favorable conditions, and the genetics respond well to structured canopy training. For experienced cannabis consumers, however, the main attraction remains the combination of strength and personality. Strawberry sweetness, lemon-lime brightness, herbs, pepper, earth, and diesel accompany a high capable of remaining lively even at potency levels that would turn many Kush hybrids into purely nighttime marijuana.
